name: Form – site search
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Form – site search.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: ARIA label
settings.how: Enter the aria label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Mode
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for mode. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Show scope select
settings.how: Turn on “Show scope select” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Default scope
settings.info: Full Shopify search supports products, articles and pages. Collections are predictive suggestions only; full submission falls back to all supported types.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for default scope. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Sources (csv)
